entities.summary: Barry Miller was an American politician who was the 28th lieutenant governor of Texas from 1925 to 1931, serving under governors Miriam A. Ferguson and Dan Moody. A member of the Democratic Party, he served in the Texas Senate from 1899 to 1903 and the Texas House of Representatives from 1917 to 1923.
